grid_check.note: thread chord changes are crossfades centred a quarter beat before their bar line

stem_sum_check.note: 24-bit quantisation of three stems bounds this at about -132 dBFS

onset_timing.note: clear rows have no other sound starting within 80 ms and no continuous sound running through them; a masked reading measures its neighbour, not a timing error (placement is sample exact)

piano_note_ons_to_nearest_attack.note: notes that start over their own sustain (repeated ostinato notes, chord tones) show no separate 6 dB rise; they are not late, only unheard as attacks

grid.note: a sixteenth is 163 ms; an attack is a 6 dB rise within 24 ms, prominent within 18 dB of its surroundings. Sustained families (pad, strings, reverb returns) have few true attacks; their readings are the patches' own slow shimmer and are not a timing measure.

scheduled.note: thread chord changes are crossfades centred a quarter beat before their bar line

transitions.note: music stem, 400 ms loudness, 100 ms hop; 'curve' is every 200 ms from one bar before to one bar after the section's bar line
